Run a dev server confined to this checkout, so a preview link of it can be shared beyond you.

Usage: termag preview run [--allow <port>,…] [--repo <dir>] [--port <port>] -- <command> [args]…

The box's agent starts <command> in a copy of the checkout you are in, under Landlock and seccomp:
it can't read the rest of your home directory, write the checkout, reach your tmux, Docker or the
agent, or connect to port 80 (instance metadata). Edits to the checkout reach it, so HMR works.
Its TCP connects reach only port 443 and the ports you --allow, on this box or anywhere: name the
app's own API or database (--allow 3001,5432), never a debugger's port. Port 80 can't be allowed.
Links for named people or for anyone on termag with the link need their port started this way.
--port sets PORT for the app. --repo names the repository in a multi-repository workstream.
Ctrl-C stops it.
  termag preview run -- npm run dev
  termag preview run --port 5173 -- npx vite --port 5173
  termag preview run --allow 3001,5432 -- npm run dev

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
